messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a progressive rollout for inference runtime v3b starting 09:30 PT. Target traffic slices: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% over ~90m. Need deploy owner, smoke owners, and rollback ready.

aj: I can own the deploy window. Will kick off the wedge at 09:30 PT.

sam: I'll handle smoke validation and metrics checks. Will run the post-deploy smoke script and confirm P50/P95.

diane: I'll watch logs and tracing, watch for error-rate and redis KV cache pressure. Ping me when we hit 5%.

maria: thanks. Quick checklist:
- deploy owner: @aj
- smoke owner: @sam
- obs lead: @diane
- rollback owner: @aj (primary) / @maria (secondary)

maria: Ramps/hold windows: 1% for 15m, 5% for 20m, 20% for 30m, then 50% if green. If any failure or >0.5% error-rate increase or P95 spike >2x baseline, rollback immediately.

aj: noted. Rollback command (in ops-runbook):
```
./deployctl rollback --tag release/v3b-20260317 --env prod
```
I'll have that ready.

sam: smoke script I'll run:
```
./tools/smoke_check.sh --targets api --qps 5 --duration 60
curl -sS https://internal-metrics/api/summary | jq '.latency.p95, .errors.rate'
```
I'll paste results in thread after each stage.

deploy-bot: Schedule created: rollout v3b -> start 2065007890 (09:30 PT), automation will shift traffic via traffic-manager in 1m buckets.

diane: monitoring list:
- latency.p50 target: <= 40ms
- latency.p95 target: <= 120ms
- errors.rate: baseline +0.25% tolerance
- cpu.gpu_util: < 85%
- kv_cache.hit_rate: not decrease >5%
If any of these breach, call rollback.

maria: cohort selection: start with internal beta and 2% of US-EAST users (slice id 7 and 12). We'll exclude EU for first 2 stages.

aj: I'll trigger the slice config:
```
traffic-manager update --add-slice slice=7,percent=1
traffic-manager update --add-slice slice=12,percent=0.0
```
Then bump to 5% by switching slice 12 to 4% and 7 to 1%.

sam: when I post smoke results I'll prefix with [SMOKE-STAGE X] so it's easy to scan. Example:
[SMOKE-STAGE 1] p50=32ms p95=78ms errors=0.05%

aj: I'll wait for your [SMOKE-STAGE 1] before moving to 5%.

maria: logging/observability hooks — please watch the new runtime tags: runtime=v3b, kernel=opt30. Traces will be labeled with tag 'v3b-rollout'.

sam: FYI I have a quick local sanity run now to warm caches. Will post quick numbers ~09:20 PT.

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed: image hash ok, infra quota ok, canary policy valid.

diane: small note — ops-sre pager rota on at 09:00-10:00 is @leo if we need paging; else normal on-call for infra.

maria: escalation: page leo -> oncall -> eng-releases channel. If rollback occurs, aj will confirm completion and post final state.

aj: ready on my side. I'll start at 09:30 PT. Sam, Diane — please be ready for quick thumbs up or rollback within hold windows. :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup: will post [SMOKE-STAGE 1] within 5m of start.

diane: :eyes:

maria: thanks team — small ask: if you see any user-facing regressions, call rollback immediately. No extended debugging during active ramp. We'll capture logs and then investigate post-rollback.

aj: copying the rollback tag here again: release/v3b-20260317. Also keeping a snapshot of previous runtime (v3a-stable) pinned so we can flip traffic back instantly.

sam: posted [SMOKE-STAGE 1] 09:37 PT: p50=35ms p95=82ms errors=0.04% cpu.gpu_util=62% kv_cache.hit_rate=92% — looks good to move to 5%

aj: moving to 5% now. Will update traffic-manager and post when done.

diane: watching traces now. No new error clusters.

aj: traffic-manager reports slice 12 -> 4% and slice 7 -> 1% applied.

sam: posted [SMOKE-STAGE 2] 09:58 PT: p50=38ms p95=95ms errors=0.06% cpu.gpu_util=68% kv_cache.hit_rate=90% — within thresholds.

maria: proceed to 20% after 20m hold.

aj: ramping to 20% over next 3m with 5% step increments.

diane: note — small uptick in long-tail but still below 2x baseline. watching closely.

sam: if anything crosses thresholds I'll call rollback.

aj: ramp complete to 20%. traffic-manager confirms.

maria: final hold for 30m, then 50% if green. If we hit any alert channeling escalation, stop ramp and rollback.

sam: [SMOKE-STAGE 3] 10:25 PT: p50=40ms p95=110ms errors=0.09% cpu.gpu_util=72% kv_cache.hit_rate=88% — borderline on p95 but still under 120ms. Recommend continue to 50% with 10m watch.

diane: agree, continue but high-sensitivity watch.

aj: starting gradual to 50% now. will pause at 35% for quick check.

maria: remind everyone: if any user reports or dashboards spike, rollback without hesitation. We can re-run validations and iterate on v3b after root cause.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 50% at 10:58 PT. Automation will continue to monitor for 2h.

sam: posting final smoke snapshot 11:05 PT: p50=42ms p95=115ms errors=0.07% cpu.gpu_util=75% kv_cache.hit_rate=87% — acceptable.

aj: great job. I'll leave the slices as-is for the next maintenance window and follow up with a short postmortem if any anomalies show in the 2h window.

maria: thanks all. I'll log a short ops note and mark rollout state in the release board. :white_check_mark:
